name: Calendar
description: The calendar library app (forge 28e): calendars, events with recurring series and their exceptions, the occurrences views and tools read, sharing at freeBusy, read or write, and the tools chat and agents use. Forge's Calendar app requires it for its pages.

commands.title: Sync an event's occurrences
commands.description: Keeps the occurrence rows of the target event (a one-off or a series' master) in step with it inside its calendar's window; sent by the app's triggers

commands.title: Share a calendar
commands.description: Shares the target calendar with a person: args {user, level freeBusy|read|write|none}

commands.title: Answer an invitation
commands.description: Sets the caller's own attendee response on the target event: args {answer accepted|tentative|declined, comment?}

commands.title: Change an occurrence of a series
commands.description: Changes an occurrence of the target series: args {recurrenceId, scope this|following|all, set}

commands.title: Mirror an outside event
commands.description: Mirrors one outside event (calendar.events@1's shape) into the target event record of a connected calendar: args {calendar, event, removed?, series?}; made when new, changed when its etag moved, deleted when removed; sent by the app's sync job

roles.title: Calendar admin
roles.description: Uses Calendar, sees every calendar (though not its events unless shared), and makes team calendars and rooms

roles.title: Calendar user
roles.description: Uses Calendar: makes their own calendars and sees and changes others' as they are shared with them

roles.title: Calendar writer
roles.description: Granted on one calendar (by the app, to its maker and those it is shared with for write): reads and changes its events

roles.title: Calendar reader
roles.description: Granted on one calendar shared for read: reads its events

roles.title: Free/busy viewer
roles.description: Granted on one calendar shared for freeBusy: sees when its events are, never what they are

triggers.title: An event changed
triggers.description: Enqueues the sync of the event's series (the calendar-syncEvent job, keyed by the series) whenever an event is made, changed or deleted

triggers.title: A calendar was made or shared
triggers.description: Grants the maker writer and each person in sharedWith their level's role, revoking what was removed

triggers.title: The window slides
triggers.description: Once a day, enqueues the sync of every one-off and series master, one job per event and day, so the window keeps its next year

triggers.title: A calendar was connected
triggers.description: Enqueues one full sync of a calendar made with a connection or given one

triggers.title: An outside event changed
triggers.description: Enqueues a delta sync of the calendars mirroring the noticed outside calendar, keyed by the calendar

triggers.title: An outside event was removed
triggers.description: Enqueues a delta sync of the calendars mirroring the noticed outside calendar, keyed by the calendar

triggers.title: Catch up outside calendars
triggers.description: Once a day, enqueues a delta sync of every connected calendar, so a lost notice is caught up within a day

triggers.title: An event was edited here
triggers.description: Enqueues the push of a person's edit of an event on a connected calendar to the outside calendar, keyed by the event

tools.name: listEvents
tools.title: List events
tools.description: The occurrences between from and to on the given calendars (every calendar the caller can see when left out), oldest first, with title, location and times; a calendar shared for free/busy shows Busy with no details

tools.name: createEvent
tools.title: Create an event
tools.description: Makes an event on a calendar: title, start and end (RFC 3339), zone, allDay, rrule for a series, location, description, attendees

tools.name: updateEvent
tools.title: Update an event
tools.description: Changes an event's fields; for an occurrence of a series give recurrenceId and scope this, following or all

tools.name: connect
tools.title: Connect outside calendars
tools.description: Makes a calendar, owned by the caller, for each calendar of an outside calendar connection the caller picks (every one when none are named), then mirrors each; give connection and optionally calendars, the outside ids from calendar.list
